The target ceiling constrains submitted intents, while existing leveraged cash/units inventory may drift. Stored open exposure is 1.2234840029 at the first resumed decision on 2021-05-25 12:00 UTC and 1.2783964637 at the final decision.
The common behavior is specific to the scaled learned means and positive scale-mean control; raw learned means submit 27/30 intents and have different paths.

This equality is evidence of identical decision paths in one reused quarter, not evidence that learned mean forecasts add useful information or generalize. Archived missingness does not identify contemporaneous live delivery.
